name: Keeper
description: Keeper is a cybersecurity and zero-knowledge password management platform for enterprises, businesses, and families, featuring encrypted password vaults, dark web monitoring (BreachWatch), and secrets management.
best_for: Security-conscious enterprises, SMBs, and families requiring zero-trust password management, SOC 2 compliance, and privileged access security.
features: Zero-knowledge, zero-trust AES-256 encrypted password and digital file vaults
BreachWatch dark web monitoring alerting users if stored credentials appear in public data breaches
KeeperFill automated browser and mobile app password generation and auto-fill
Granular role-based access controls, admin console policies, and automated SCIM user provisioning
Secure record sharing with time-limited access and emergency digital legacy recovery
Keeper Secrets Manager for protecting API keys, certificates, and developer credentials

tiers.name: Personal
tiers.notes: Unlimited password storage across all devices (billed annually at $35/yr).

tiers.name: Family
tiers.notes: 5 private vaults and 10GB secure cloud storage (billed annually at $75/yr).

tiers.name: Business Starter
tiers.notes: Up to 10 users, encrypted vaults, and folder sharing (billed annually).

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Unlimited users, security audit reporting, and admin console.

pros: Rigorous zero-trust, zero-knowledge security architecture certified for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP
Comprehensive enterprise feature set including Secrets Manager and automated SCIM provisioning
Family plan provides 5 isolated vaults with shared folder permissions
cons: BreachWatch dark web monitoring and secure cloud storage require separate paid add-ons on basic plans
No perpetual free plan for multi-device sync (free tier restricted to single mobile device without cloud sync)
Admin configuration console has a slight learning curve for non-technical managers

alternatives.name: 1Password
alternatives.description: Leading password manager for businesses and families featuring Watchtower security audits.
alternatives.best_for: Teams and families wanting a polished user experience and Travel Mode protection

alternatives.name: Bitwarden
alternatives.description: Open-source password manager with transparent zero-knowledge encryption and self-hosting.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and budget-conscious teams seeking open-source security

alternatives.name: Dashlane
alternatives.description: Password manager featuring integrated VPN and dark web credential monitoring.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting built-in VPN privacy alongside password management
